# Kuailu HR | Target Customers

| Customer or role | Needs supported by the supplied materials |
| --- | --- |
| HR Specialist | Maintain employee records, onboarding, HR transactions, attendance profiles, compensation profiles and exception follow-up |
| System Administrator | Configure master data, workflow automation, attendance rules, payroll rules, permissions and notifications |
| Department Manager | View department information and participate in regularization, transfer, offboarding and leave approvals |
| Employee | View personal records and submit regularization, offboarding, leave, punch-correction, overtime and business-travel requests |
| Hong Kong multi-site employer (planning hypothesis) | The PMF report identifies 50–500 employees, 3–30 branches, and a high part-time / shift-work mix as a beachhead hypothesis. This is a planning assumption, not a confirmed customer segment. |
